mapper.select: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(o.pay_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS label, SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_type = 'NORMAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS orderCount, SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_type = 'NORMAL' THEN od.unit_price * od.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS orderAmount, SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_type = 'REFUND' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS refundCount, SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_type = 'REFUND' THEN od.unit_price * od.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS refundAmount FROM order_details od LEFT JOIN orders o ON od.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'PAID' AND o.pay_time >= #{params.start} AND o.pay_time <= #{params.end} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(o.pay_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY label ASC
